title: Binary: A Puzzling Platformer
description:
Binary is a game that requires players to mix the ability to solve puzzles and effectively platform. It is about Bit, a piece of computer data, trying to find his fellow bits who got lost in a data transfer.Features• Emphasis on precise platforming and puzzle gameplay.

• Artwork in a unique blend of vector graphics and pixel art that captures the feeling of a digital world.

• 6 levels, each with unique features including mouse-movable platforms, ferocious viruses (no, they will not infect your computer), player-changing processors, and more!

• Original Soundtrack with distinct personalities and feelings.
Controls• WASD Or Arrow Keys to Move

• Space to Jump
